finding.classification: Intentional refusal of an installed transport state outside the current, frozen-prior, or authenticated paired-predecessor contract.
finding.observedCanonicalGeneration: All 9 recorded canonical Lead transport members and its manifest match main 14a4e74a; this is a transport-generation claim, not a claim about the entire installed system.
finding.observedClaudePeer: Unrecognized member mixture: 7 of 9 member hashes differ from both the canonical generation and the retained 8d payload. Exact historical SDK revision is not established; only 5 of 9 match c835cc3776ce53afe9e704a6e213c2c6dbb48e44.
finding.sourceValidation: The source manifest and private canonical stage are validated before destination-state admission. Reaching the atomic-state refusal distinguishes this branch from source manifest validation failure.
finding.predecessorRule: _transport_predecessor at line 7718 requires a valid canonical receipt/tree plus canonical and peer members that all match the same canonical manifest digest vector; recorded 7-member disagreement prevents this qualification, regardless of the previously uncaptured peer-manifest hash.
finding.sparseRoutes: All nine peer members are present; seven do not match the desired payload. Empty, limited two-current-member, all-current, and legacy-singleton sparse routes cannot admit this recorded state.
finding.frozenPriorRule: None of the 13 accepted frozen prior vectors matches the recorded peer members; the unknown original peer-manifest hash cannot repair those member mismatches.
finding.optionalPeerRule: _preflight_canonical_skills (10408-10424) permits an optional Claude peer to remain unclaimed without a predecessor. Claude installation requires transport admission; the Codex preview can pass while this Claude preview refuses.
finding.effect: No transport stage is returned and application is not authorized. The recorded dry-run exited 1 at 6.610 seconds with complete unforced native Job closure.
finding.sourceDefectConclusion: This diagnosis does not identify a source regression or retained-package corruption. The observed unsupported installed-state mismatch is sufficient to explain the refusal. No production guard, frozen allowlist, installed peer, or receipt was modified.

limits.originalSnapshotCoverage: 965 metadata entries and 608 content hashes unchanged; all 1860 retained-package files unchanged, as recorded by the existing preview evidence.
limits.uncapturedPeerManifest: The named Claude peer manifest was absent from the original before/after captures. A fresh metadata-only observation cannot establish retrospective content or metadata unchangedness.
limits.freshMetadata: Only the named physical path and its ordinary ancestor chain were inspected. No peer manifest content was opened or hashed in this diagnosis.
limits.noRecallLimit: Metadata guards are not an OS atomic no-recall handle. No broader no-recall or whole-profile guarantee is claimed.
limits.traceLimit: The precise earlier return or caught refusal inside _transport_predecessor was not instrumented; the recorded member mismatch independently prevents a qualified predecessor.
